reply.keys: exactly release; any other key or type refuses the reply
reply.manifest_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits: the digest of the approved release manifest the node is serving
reply.assets: integer 2..4096: how many files that manifest lists
reply.source: the approved release the frontdoor loaded: the manifest digest and the asset count

refresh: on load, on request, and every 60 seconds while the page is visible; a read that is superseded is ignored

screen.release: one card from the node: CHECKING, then REPORTED with the digest in groups of eight and the file count; a failed read removes the last good report, hides the values and shows the shared icon and short service state
screen.facts_of_the_release: three cards that print whether or not the node answers, because none of them is a claim about the node: language and appearance, the limits the app keeps (read from app/core: FD4_LIMITS, MAX_RPC_BYTES, RPC_DEADLINE_MS), and how settings change

states.initial: heading, purpose and the three fact cards at once; the release card reads CHECKING
states.loading: the same, until the first read settles
states.empty: not applicable: a release always lists its files
states.refusal: release card shows the shared short refusal state without the service code; only a confirmed ended session asks for sign-in
states.service-unavailable: release card shows a muted icon and Not yet, with its data hidden; malformed replies remain refusals
states.phone: cards stack and fact rows become one column at 480 px and below

face_holds: a digest and a count; it has no field that saves a setting and no control that approves one
